checkpoint.evidence: PR #1573 merged at 5bf811890511d82481d8eb60048a84a18da427e5. The current compiler independently screens the U-notched cover, washer dependency and offset first rest for both inlet branches. Main 37694c24 retains the exact cover source and regression fixtures; all six main removal and cover tests passed.
checkpoint.next: Detail the independently retained filler and seals for the rear-open U-notch and preserve each vent/weather return. Dimension the rated Z900 disconnect and its pilot/tool retreat, anchor a dry guide and prove continuous positive support through an offset first-rest handover. Then dry-fit the actual assemblies and challenge wet/pressure closure with the sibling sealed.
checkpoint.blocker: The installed washer removes 7 mm Utility and 42 mm Plant from required cover axial travel. The restrained state admits geometric cover rest only; material seals, anchorage, supported motion, actual latches and product compatibility remain open.
